title: Account Credit for FloodGuard Policyholders with a Larkspur Umbrella
content:
Conditions of the account credit on the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy renewal term premium for customers holding the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy.

## Condition

An account credit reduces the renewal term premium by 3 percent when the customer holds a Larkspur Umbrella policy in force whose underlying schedule lists, and has not since removed, the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy in force at the same property address as the flood policy; by 1 percent when the customer holds a Larkspur Umbrella policy in force whose underlying schedule does not list that HomeGuard policy or has removed it; and by nothing when the customer holds no Larkspur Umbrella policy in force.

## Reading the underlying schedule

The umbrella's underlying schedule is the run of entries on the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy scheduling underlying home policies, by policy number, and removing them. The HomeGuard policy is listed and not since removed when the entries scheduling its policy number outnumber the entries removing it.

## Combinations

| Larkspur Umbrella policy in force | Its schedule lists, and has not since removed, the HomeGuard policy in force at the same address | Account credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 3 percent |
| Yes | No — never listed, or listed and then removed | 1 percent |
| No | — | No credit |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- The HomeGuard policy was scheduled on the umbrella in March and removed in September of the same year: removed, so 1 percent.
- The HomeGuard policy was scheduled, removed, then scheduled again: listed and not since removed, so 3 percent.
- The customer's umbrella was cancelled before the renewal is recorded and no other Larkspur Umbrella policy is in force: no credit.
